name: @singularity/plugin-conversations-transcript-source
description: A conversation's transcript, host-independent: the Claude Code JSONL format (core: the event protocol and its helpers), the parser every host runs (server: mergeChainLines / buildJsonlEvents), and the TranscriptSource host service (its events, a signature that moves with them, a watch). The desktop's provider reads the session files (transcript-watcher#machine); a host without them provides its own (plugins/memory).
